sentences.text:
THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ORDERS THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: THE HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE CHILLAKUR SUMALATHA  ORAL JUDGMENT (PER: THE HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE CHILLAKUR SUMALATHA) Sri. B. M. Patil, learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant died three years back and the legal representatives of the appellant are not interested in prosecuting the matter.
Learned counsel seeks to dismiss the appeal as abated.
Memo to that effect is also filed.
Having considered the submission thus made by learned counsel for the appellant as well as basing on the NC: 2025:KHC-D:14970 HC-KAR contents of the memo filed, the appeal is dismissed as abated.
Consequently, pending interlocutory application is also dismissed.
